# Security policy

Security fixes target the default branch (`main`).
Older tags do not receive security backports.

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.
Report privately through [GitHub vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/TryUniCAD/Kit/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected revision, reproduction steps, and potential impact.

See the [repository security policy](../SECURITY.md) for scope and handling.
